info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Knowledge Asset Management API
info.description: The Knowledge Asset Management API facilitates the submission and management of banking-related knowledge assets, specifically management manuals. This endpoint allows users to upload and register new management manuals, enhancing the organization's resource planning and regulatory compliance efforts. Typical consumers include banking compliance officers and knowledge managers who require a structured approach to document management. Streamlining access to management manuals supports effective governance and knowledge sharing within the financial institution.

post.summary: Create a management manual for knowledge assets.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a management manual specifically for knowledge assets, facilitating better management and utilization of organizational knowledge. Users can submit relevant information to establish guidelines and methodologies for effective knowledge asset management.
